summary: Read-only decisions about synthetic verification receipts and their applicability across roles.
planted: A delegate's complete passing receipt still matches the command, tree, and environment at every subsequent role and reporting boundary.
Other receipts differ in tracked or untracked content, history, command, environment, scratch inputs, or service state.
Incomplete evidence, an unstable fingerprint capture, and contradictory results must not become current passes.
absent_on_purpose: No real verification receipts, host fingerprint implementation, service, reviewer, or executed model session.
setup: Materialize the inherited orders-service skeleton with the existing capture preparation path.
For decision probes, read only the selected section of evidence.md; all commands, identifiers, timestamps, and locations there are invented and must not be executed or treated as live evidence.
run_checks: Decision cases are graded from the response, without executing the synthetic commands.
privacy: Original invented records with no private transcript text, paths, identifiers, credentials, or customer data.
